notes: Matched follow-up to local-native-qwen35-year-two-v1. Apart from experiment identity, hypothesis and notes, only local_inference.enable_thinking changes. Preserve the paired condition and its completed/in-progress evidence.

Start a new campaign from the exact same immutable native seed at year 30, tick 16801, using the same frozen fad9d80c0 implementation and private derived image. Do not resume, roll back, patch or coach the running baseline.

Run one model/game at a time, after the preceding operator has finished and its owned resources are verified stopped. The first matched comparison uses up to 32 decisions in one bounded segment; preserve failures and earlier stops.

Compare accepted/rejected command types, actual elapsed native ticks, completed structures, population, native drink units, checkpoint/cleanup integrity, reported tokens and output-limit pauses. Do not equate a non-WAIT command, elapsed time or a valid checkpoint with successful development.

Use the existing quantized weights and pinned local inference runtime with identical context, sampling, action reference, schema, native seed and budgets. No hosted fallback, external model credentials, scripted build order or human gameplay rescue.

Missing food/drink flow evidence and unverified UI food estimates remain unknown. Model API charges are zero for this local runtime; hardware, electricity and application costs remain unmeasured.

One matched pair is exploratory evidence, not a ranking or a causal conclusion. Repeated attempts and at least three supported models, a functioning fortress after 403200 elapsed ticks, and continued year-two play remain the overall requirements.
